creator: Alexander Terp
description:
amterp, Chat Notes 2026-10-28: "agent retract human message if addressed else how". At triage on 2026-11-01 he explained "else how": the matter was addressed by another route.

An agent posts to `@human`, and the matter is settled some other way before the human reads it: the agent works it out itself, or the human answers in the agent's pane. The banner or notification stays up and the message stays unread, so the human reads something already moot. A question somebody else answers already comes down from the banner on its own (`docs/cli/msg.md`, "The human"). A plain message has no equivalent, and no `muster msg` verb withdraws a post.

Wanted: the agent that posted a message can retract it, which takes down its banner or notification and marks it retracted in the conversation rather than deleting it. Open: whether only the author may retract, and whether a retracted message still counts as unread.
title: An agent cannot retract a message to the human once it is settled another way
